designPrompt:
KOI MAHAKAM — MENU DESIGN BRIEF
Generate only when explicitly requested. Use MAHAKAM LUNCH DINNER 20260605A.pdf as the visual reference and current saved Mahakam data as the content source. Match its native 538.81 × 348 point landscape format; do not substitute Kemang or Kuningan geometry.
White background, centered solid black condensed LUNCH & DINNER title, no-pork/no-lard statement below, two-column icon legend at upper right, red double rule beneath the header. Do not add a logo not present in the source unless supplied and requested.
Use four columns with red outlined narrow uppercase category headings, thin red rules, compact black dish text, smaller descriptions and right-aligned prices. Prices are IDR × 1,000. Keep variants/add-ons attached to their dish and use the restaurant's assigned icon artwork, including its vanilla ice cream icon.
Reference order by columns: Small Bites, Soups, Salads, Pastas; Beef, Grill, Lamb, Sauce; Seafood, Poultry, Burger & Sandwich; Noodles & Rice, Side Dishes, Dessert, Ice Cream & Sorbet. Preserve deliberate changes in the current saved category and item order. Reflow whole categories without dropping content or shrinking text to unreadability.
Monthly Specials has a red outlined panel across the lower central columns, with Salad, Pasta and Main left; Dessert and Wine of the Month right. Adapt to present groups, omit empty ones, and preserve current bottle/glass prices without restoring the old crossed-out bottle price. Ice Cream & Sorbet uses a compact bordered panel at the lower right in the reference.
Use original vector heading letterforms; for new headings compose matching source glyphs rather than Arial Narrow substitutes. Leave a small gap between leading icons and dish text. Within each category, draw a black horizontal divider between European and Asian dishes when the currently available dishes form two contiguous cuisine groups in the saved order (either cuisine first). Use the saved cuisine values and place the divider at the cuisine transition, matching the original reference line style, with enough vertical space that it cannot look like strike-through text. Preserve the saved dish order; do not reorder dishes or guess missing cuisine values to create a divider. Omit the divider only when cuisines are mixed, uncertain, or only one cuisine group is present. Apply this rule consistently, including Seafood and Beef. Keep the red category rules and panel borders.
Footer uses current service/tax wording and a current version date. Readable complete content takes priority over forcing one page; use matching continuation pages only if necessary. Do not display internal product codes on the printed menu unless requested.
Verify every visible item, price, option, code association and assigned icon against the current data. Render every page to inspect typography, spacing, clipping and collisions. Imported content remains for review. Saving this prompt does not generate a PDF.
